title: Chapter 554
paragraphs: Chapter 554
Episode 145. Premonition (23)
Ron's aura turned ash-colored.
A discomforting sensation of his entire body being eroded by a dark force began, and his vision went pitch black.
The great physical body, which he had honed his whole life without a single private passion, now exuded a dull and ominous energy.

The invisible sword also began to lose its unique transparent color and emit a dull gray hue. As a result, it lost its uniqueness of being invisible, but it was not a weakness due to the sheer size of the power from the beginning.
The wizards of Zipil could only realize again how vast the pressure they were facing was, when the invisible sword took form due to the Overlord Sword.
The whole sky and the earth were filled with gray sword energy. Furthermore, as soon as the Overlord Sword opened, the power grew even more, and wherever they looked, they could only see gray blades.
But now, the wizards of Zipil were not afraid of him.
The power of the opened Demon God Stone not only enhanced Kelliak Zipil, but also all other wizards and the fleet of Zipil.

The dragons roared incessantly. They did not attack their allies because they lost their rationality due to the energy of the Demon God Stone. They were like well-trained fighting dogs, just waiting for an order. An order to bite the enemy.
Kaaa-!
Excluding Kelliak, the one who showed the most overwhelming presence was undoubtedly Belrot.
As per the energy of the Demon God Stone, Belrot vomited black fire, and the intense heat, incomparable to before, was pushing back the nearby gray sword energies.
Hoo...
Ron slowly evened his breath and took his stance. The newly engraved pattern of the Overlord Sword slightly covered his emaciated body.
His physical condition wasn't great. Therefore, his Overlord Sword couldn't last longer than the sword spirits, but that wasn't important.
The fight probably wouldn't last long.
Suddenly, Ron High.
He felt a common point between that Demon God Stone, which constantly screams horrible sounds, and the 'White Stone'.
The White Stone, the greatest enemy of the High family.

The ominous gravel, the wedge pointing to the end, the successive heads of the High family referred to the White Stone by several names. Nobody knew the real name of the stone, and nobody could cut the stone.

The existence of the stone, only passed down from head to head, lay in 'cutting' it. Only by reaching the level where they can cut it, could they stand tall at the highest place in the history of the High family.
And so far, no head of the High family has cut the stone.
In the end, that stone pushed High into a crisis, and it was still whispering the language of destruction, holding Dante captive.
The Demon God Stone did the same.
The White Stone, the Demon God Stone. If they can't cut them, the High will disappear from the world today.
"Come, shameless monsters."
Swoosh-!
When Ron lifted Rashid, it seemed as if an ash-colored mountain sprang up suddenly in front of Sword Emperor City. The sword energy formed a barrier in place of the collapsed and shattered walls.
Another black flash was shooting from Hurroti. This dark force again pierced the ash-colored barrier that had sprung up layer upon layer without hesitation.
However, before Kelliak could confirm that the black flash reached Ron, he had to face the sharp sword energy flying through the cracks in the ash-colored barrier.
However, the sword energy vanished abruptly before it reached Kelliak's face. As if dust disappeared before it touched the fire.
The power of the Demon God Stone was protecting Kelliak and the fleet like that. Hundreds of sword energies shot out one after another also vanished in the same way.
Kelliak slowly reached out to the afterimage left by the vanished sword energy. He could only feel the slight heat generated by the Demon God Stone's power neutralizing the sword energy.
He didn't take any action to defend or avoid actively. Kelliak just showed a little will not to get hit, but it blocked Ron's sword energy perfectly.
'...Shiron, has he always felt this way when he sees those who oppose him?'
Kelliak thought as he swung Hurroti again.
The ash-colored sword energies that Ron spread by opening the Overlord Sword were ruthlessly torn every time he swung Hurroti.
The attacks of the wizard, dragon, and fleet, which were continually blocked by the invisible sword energy, worked much more effectively than before.
Until the Demon God Stone opened, Ron didn't dodge their attacks even once.
He either vanished them with the invisible sword wind before they approached him or blocked them by standing still.
But now, Ron was sweating profusely, moving back and forth in the void formed by the walls and his ash-colored sword energy.
Ron was not annoyed by that fact.
He just silently held the sword, watched the battle, and counterattacked whenever he had a chance.
As the seconds passed, more scars were added above the pattern of the Overlord Sword engraved on his body.
[Ahhhh!]

Like a tidal wave, Belrot's black flame rushed into Sword Emperor City. The ash-colored barrier exploded, and 30% of the left wall was completely destroyed. Ron blocked the front to prevent Belrot from entering through that gap.

As Belrot charged, the space distorted, and shockwaves and roars occurred. Ron's Rashid, swung to face him head-on, hit Belrot's head but didn't cut it. It was as if swords were touching and having a power struggle.
When the clash ended, Belot was the first to retreat, but it was Ron who was bleeding. A mouthful of hot, burning blood was refluxing into his throat.
"Kahak...!"
He spat out blood, and before that blood hit the ground, black flames and a flash of light enveloped Ron. The flames pierced his chest, the flash pricked his shoulder.

As a result, he momentarily lost balance, which gave the fleet and the dragons an opportunity to bomb him. It was the first time since he gained the name 'Sword Emperor' that he had been subjected to such a one-sided attack.
Kiiee...!
The Magic Stone seemed to continue to mock Ron. The magicians of Zieph, the dragons, and Belot felt that way. They were already intoxicated with victory and madness.
However, Kelliac thought differently.
'The Magic Stone...it seems uneasy. Does it perceive Ron as a threat?'
As Kelliac, he couldn't quickly understand the reason.
The battle was overwhelmingly one-sided. Even if Ron still had some power left, Kelliac himself had only used a portion of the Magic Stone's power.
Nevertheless, there was no room for doubt, even if he didn't understand. Over thirty gods resided in the Magic Stone, and their combined will produced an absolute conclusion.
Kelliac's gaze landed on the ground. Jin and his party, who had just entered the castle to avoid the aftermath of the battle, and the pursuing Octavia and Phantom Brigade could be seen.
Ron was unable to fully exert his power as he was trying to prevent the shock from reaching there.
'Maybe it's due to the power of the shadow residing in Jin Lunkundel.'
Compared to what Andrei had, it was much greater, but the Magic Stone was not yet in its complete state.
Shadow.
Without obtaining the power of Soldelet, the Magic Stone could never be complete. Even if all the powers of the gods who had already died or been annihilated were combined.
"Where are you looking, Kelliac!"
Ron's sword aura broke through the bombardment and came right up to Kelliac's nose.
Unlike before, he couldn't extinguish the sword aura with just a light will. When he swung Huroti to erase the sword aura, his wrist felt numb.
Despite being fused with the Magic Stone, the fact that he could still feel pain was surprisingly new.
He thought that a long time ago, a race that had disappeared while opposing the gods must have provoked the gods' anger in this way.
"Don't worry. Killing you is the first order of business."
Koooh...!
Like a tumor, a sphere of black flame began to form in the sky.
Five Destructor Flame Gems, altered by Kelliac and enhanced by the Magic Stone, were aiming at Ron. In terms of sheer power, they were superior to even the second type of Liol's legacy.
Despite seeing this, Ron did not withdraw the power used for ground defense. Kelliac frowned as if he was displeased with this.
"Did my words sound like lies to you?"
Following the guidance of Kelriak's staff, a black fire orb fell towards the Sword Emperor's Castle first. Belrot continued to press Ron, ensuring that he couldn't dodge the black fire orb.
However, Ron had no intention of avoiding it from the beginning.
Shiiiiii...!
The Ashen Rashid let out a low resonant sound, and the mark of the Overlord's Sword engraved on Ron's body deepened. Ron, looking up at Belrot and the black fire orb, had solid, unwavering grey eyes.
Overlord's Sword First Combat Mode
Rashid emitted a grey radiance.
Even the Belrot enhanced by the Demon Stone instinctively retreated due to the massive energy that absorbed the black aura spread around.

The ashen light, riding on the sword, endlessly gushed out and replaced the place, revealing the majesty of the Overlord. At that moment, the expression on the Demon Stone, looming ominously like a moon, crumbled.
'This sword is like…'
Kelriak could not help but recall a sword he had once faced from its appearance.
The Overlord's Sword was originally made to model the sword of Runcandel for their decisive battle.
Therefore, all swords of the Overlord resemble Runcandel, but that doesn't mean it's just a clumsy imitation executed by a mortal body without blessing.
The Overlord's Sword was made to defeat Runcandel.
Meteor Breaker
Runcandel's Third Combat Mode, Meteor Rain.
The sword that Kelriak recalled was the third combat mode of Runcandel, which Shiron himself had executed, and the first combat mode of the Overlord's Sword was.
It is a sword made to overcome that. Runcandel's Meteor Rain.
Following the trajectory of Rashid, the void split in half from all around. The ashen sword aura that gushed out from the gap stole the space eroded by the black fire, and took it back.
Kaaaaah, Aaaaaah!
The voice of the Demon Stone carried a deeper sense of anxiety and rage than before. It seemed to say, dare a human possess such power?
Belrot screamed as he pulled out his body. He couldn't block the ashen aura of the Meteor Breaker that was about to explode.
As soon as Belrot dodged, Kelriak dropped the remaining four black fire orbs all at once, but they didn't gain speed due to the counterforce.
It's not even that; they were scattering before they even reached the wall. The five fire orbs, already irregular in shape to be called spheres, were losing their power.
"I never thought I'd have to use the power of the Demon Stone against you. You said so just a while ago... I feel the same way."
"It's not just hidden power... you're not becoming stronger while fighting me, are you?"
Kelriak affirmed with narrowed eyes, and Ron grabbed a handful of scattering black fire and extinguished it in his fist.
"Regardless of how this fight ends today... both you and I will lose a lot. And the real winner will not be you or me. It will be the children."
